item.title: Go Concurrency Model
item.description: Go’s concurrency model builds on CSP, providing Goroutines and Channels as core tools. An overview of how each works and when to choose what.

item.title: concurrency-go
item.description: A record of implementing and benchmarking three Go concurrency patterns — mutex, channel, and lock-free — to build hands-on understanding.

item.title: rust-server
item.description: A record of implementing the multithreaded HTTP server from Rust Book Chapter 20, experiencing how ownership and concurrency safety are enforced at the type level.
